title: Damaged meal container makes the food unusable
facts_text: I verified my account and order. It was delivered two hours ago. The noodle bowl's container was crushed and the food spilled into the delivery bag, so that meal is unusable. The other items are fine. I took a photo of the damaged container and spill. I cannot accept this delivery
request: Please refund the noodle bowl and its tax.
base_rule: Report damaged-item issues within 48 hours of delivery. For a verified damaged item, refund the affected item and its applicable tax; if the verified issue makes the entire order unusable, refund the full order, including delivery and service fees. When reasonably available, review order records or request a photo, but do not deny a claim solely because a photo is unavailable. If food may be unsafe, advise the customer not to consume it and promptly escalate the report to the food-safety team.
